en.s: The siege of Damietta occurred in 1249 and was part of the Seventh Crusade. Louis IX of France landed at Damietta in 1249. Egypt would, Louis thought, provide a base from which to attack Jerusalem, and its wealth and supply of grain would keep the crusaders fed and equipped. On 6 June Damietta was taken with little resistance from the Egyptians, who withdrew further up the Nile.

zh.s: 达米埃塔围城战发生于1249年，是第七次十字军东征的一部分。法国国王路易九世于1249年在达米埃塔登陆。他认为埃及可作为进攻耶路撒冷的基地，其财富和粮食供应也能为十字军提供补给。6月6日，达米埃塔几乎没有遭遇埃及人抵抗便被攻占；埃及军队向尼罗河上游撤退。

en.s: The 1505 Lo Mustang earthquake (Nepali: सन् १५०५ को मुस्ताङ भूकम्प) occurred on 6 June 1505 and had an estimated magnitude between 8.2 and 8.8 making it one of the largest earthquakes in Nepalese history. The earthquake killed an approximate 30 percent of the Nepalese population at the time. The earthquake was located in northern Nepal and also affected southern China and northern India.

zh.s: 1505年洛木斯塘地震（尼泊尔语：सन् १५०५ को मुस्ताङ भूकम्प）发生于1505年6月6日，估计震级为8.2至8.8级，是尼泊尔历史上规模最大的地震之一。当地约30%的人口在地震中死亡。震中位于尼泊尔北部，地震也影响了中国南部和印度北部。

en.s: The Battle of Novara was a battle of the War of the League of Cambrai fought on June 6, 1513, near Novara, in Northern Italy.

zh.s: 诺瓦拉战役是康布雷同盟战争中的一场战役，于1513年6月6日在意大利北部诺瓦拉附近爆发。

en.t: Swedish regent Gustav Vasa is elected King of Sweden and, marking a symbolic end to the Kalmar Union, 6 June is designated the country's national day
en.s: Gustav Eriksson Vasa (12 May 1496 – 29 September 1560), also known as Gustav I, was King of Sweden from 1523 until his death in 1560. He was previously self-recognised Protector of the Realm (Riksföreståndare) from 1521, during the Swedish War of Liberation against King Christian II of Denmark, Norway and Sweden. Gustav rose to lead this war following the Stockholm Bloodbath, where his father was executed.

zh.t: 古斯塔夫·瓦萨当选瑞典国王
zh.s: 古斯塔夫·埃里克松·瓦萨（1496年5月12日—1560年9月29日），又称古斯塔夫一世，自1523年起担任瑞典国王直至去世。1521年起，他在瑞典解放战争期间自称王国护国公，领导瑞典反抗丹麦、挪威和瑞典国王克里斯蒂安二世；他的父亲在斯德哥尔摩惨案中遭处决。

en.s: The 1587 battle of Sendaigawa was part of the Kyūshū Campaign undertaken by warlord Toyotomi Hideyoshi towards the end of Japan's Sengoku period. The Sendai River (Sendaigawa) was among the final obstacles to Hideyoshi's attack on Kagoshima, the center of the Shimazu clan's domains. Toyotomi Hideyoshi and his half-brother Hashiba Hidenaga met a Shimazu clan force, led by Niiro Tadamoto, near the river.

zh.s: 1587年的川内川之战是丰臣秀吉在日本战国末期发动的九州征伐的一部分。川内川是丰臣军进攻岛津氏领地中心鹿儿岛前的最后几道障碍之一。丰臣秀吉与同父异母的弟弟羽柴秀长在河边遭遇新纳忠元率领的岛津军。

en.s: The Battle of Vitebsk, part of the Russo–Polish War of 1654–1667, took place on 5–6 June 1664 near Vitebsk. It was fought between the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth led by Michał Kazimierz Pac against the Tsardom of Russia led by Ivan Nikitich Khovansky. It ended with a Polish–Lithuanian victory.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 维捷布斯克战役是1654—1667年俄波战争的一部分，于1664年6月5日至6日在维捷布斯克附近爆发。交战双方是米哈乌·卡齐米日·帕茨率领的波兰立陶宛联邦军与伊万·尼基季奇·霍万斯基率领的俄罗斯沙皇国军队。波兰立陶宛联邦获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Solebay took place on 6 June 1672 New Style, during the Third Anglo-Dutch War, near Southwold, Suffolk, in eastern England. A Dutch fleet under Michiel de Ruyter attacked a combined Anglo-French force in one of the largest naval battles of the Age of Sail. Fighting continued much of the day, but ended at sunset without a clear victory.

zh.s: 索尔湾海战于1672年6月6日（新历）爆发，是第三次英荷战争的一部分，地点在英格兰东部萨福克郡绍斯沃尔德附近。米歇尔·德·鲁伊特率领的荷兰舰队袭击了英法联军。这是帆船时代规模最大的海战之一。战斗持续了大半天，日落时结束，双方都没有取得明确胜利。

en.t: Shivaji is crowned Chhatrapati at Raigad Fort
en.s: On June 6, 1674, Shivaji was formally crowned at Raigad Fort in present-day Maharashtra, India. Taking the title Chhatrapati, he publicly affirmed his rule over the Maratha kingdom he had built.
en.n: Coronation ceremony at Raigad Fort.

zh.t: 希瓦吉在赖加德堡加冕为“恰特拉帕蒂”
zh.s: 1674年6月6日，希瓦吉在今印度马哈拉施特拉邦的赖加德堡正式加冕，称“恰特拉帕蒂”，公开确立自己对所建马拉塔王国的统治。
zh.n: 加冕仪式在赖加德堡举行。

en.s: The 1705 English general election saw contests in 110 constituencies in England and Wales, roughly 41% of the total. The election was fiercely fought, with mob violence and cries of "Church in Danger" occurring in several boroughs. During the previous session of Parliament the Tories had become increasingly unpopular, and their position was therefore somewhat weakened by the election, particularly by the Tackers controversy.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1705年英格兰大选在英格兰和威尔士的110个选区举行竞争性选举，约占全部选区的41%。竞选十分激烈，多个城镇发生暴民暴力，出现“教会危在旦夕”的口号。前一届议会期间，托利党日益失去民众支持，因此在本次选举中处于弱势，尤其受到《接受法案》争议影响。

en.s: On June 6, 1736, a party of twenty one French explorers led by Jean Baptiste de La Vérendrye were massacred by Lakota and Dakota warriors on an island in Lake of the Woods. The massacre came about as a result of a recent French alliance with the Cree, who, under French protection, had been attacking Lakotas.

zh.s: 1736年6月6日，让-巴蒂斯特·德·拉韦朗德里率领的21名法国探险者在伍兹湖的一座岛上遭拉科塔族和达科他族战士杀害。惨案起因是法国近期与克里族结盟；在法国庇护下，克里族一直在攻击拉科塔族。

en.s: The Battle of Jacobshavn (Danish: Søslaget ved Jacobshavn, Dutch: Slag bij maklykout Greenlandic: Ilulissani qaleruaq eqqaani) also referred to as the Battle of Ilulissat, was a battle between Danish and Dutch ships over the control of Ilulissat (then Jacobshavn) on 6 June 1739. It has been the only naval battle fought over the rights of Greenland.

zh.s: 雅各布港海战又称伊卢利萨特海战（丹麦语：Søslaget ved Jacobshavn；荷兰语：Slag bij Maklykout；格陵兰语：Ilulissani qaleruaq eqqaani），于1739年6月6日爆发。丹麦和荷兰舰船为争夺伊卢利萨特（当时称雅各布港）的控制权而战。这是唯一一场围绕格陵兰权益进行的海战。

en.s: The siege of Havana was the capture of the Spanish-held city of Havana, Cuba in 1762 as part of the war between Britain and Spain which formed part of the larger Seven Years' War. After the Spanish abandoned their former policy of neutrality by signing the family compact with France, Britain declared war on Spain in January 1762.
en.n: Seven Years' War: British forces begin the Siege of Havana and temporarily capture the city.

zh.s: 哈瓦那围城战是英国于1762年攻占西班牙控制的古巴哈瓦那，属于英西战争的一部分，也是更大的七年战争的一部分。1762年1月，西班牙放弃此前的中立政策，与法国签署家族协定后，英国对西班牙宣战。
zh.n: 七年战争：英军开始围攻哈瓦那并一度占领该城。

en.s: The siege of Augusta took place between May 22 and June 6, 1781, during the American Revolutionary War. 1,600 Patriot troops, led by Brigadier General Andrew Pickens and Lieutenant Colonel Henry Lee III successfully besieged Augusta, Georgia, which was defended by 600 Loyalist troops under Thomas Brown.

zh.s: 奥古斯塔围城战于1781年5月22日至6月6日进行，是美国独立战争的一部分。安德鲁·皮肯斯准将和亨利·李三世中校率领1,600名爱国者军队，成功围攻佐治亚州奥古斯塔；城镇由托马斯·布朗率领的600名效忠派军队防守。

en.s: The Battle of Szczekociny was fought on the 6 June 1794 near the town of Szczekociny, Lesser Poland, between Poland and the combined forces of the Russian Empire and Kingdom of Prussia. Polish forces were led by Tadeusz Kościuszko, and the Russians and Prussians by Alexander Tormasov, future eminent general of the Napoleonic Wars. Tormasov was aided by Prussian General Francis Favrat, who emphasized the use of artillery, which put Russian-Prussian forces in the advantage.

zh.s: 什切科奇内战役于1794年6月6日在小波兰什切科奇内镇附近爆发，交战双方是波兰军队与俄罗斯帝国和普鲁士王国联军。塔德乌什·科希丘什科率领波兰军队；亚历山大·托尔马索夫率领俄军和普军，他后来成为拿破仑战争中的著名将领。普鲁士将军弗朗西斯·法夫拉特协助托尔马索夫，并强调使用火炮，使俄普联军占据优势。

en.s: In the Battle of Guttstadt-Deppen on 5 and 6 June 1807, troops of the Russian Empire led by General Levin August, Count von Bennigsen attacked the First French Empire corps of Marshal Michel Ney. The Russians pressed back their opponents in an action that saw Ney fight a brilliant rear guard action with his heavily outnumbered forces. During the 6th, Ney successfully disengaged his troops and pulled back to the west side of the Pasłęka (Passarge) River. The action occurred during the War of the Fourth Coalition, part of the Napoleonic Wars.

zh.s: 古特施塔特—德彭战役于1807年6月5日至6日爆发。莱文·奥古斯特·冯·贝尼希森伯爵率领俄罗斯帝国军队，进攻米歇尔·内伊元帅指挥的法兰西第一帝国军团。俄军一度压制对手，内伊率领人数处于劣势的部队展开出色的后卫战。6月6日，内伊成功脱离交战，率军撤至帕森塔河（帕萨尔格河）西岸。此战是第四次反法同盟战争的一部分，也属于拿破仑战争。

en.s: The battle of Valdepeñas (Spanish: Contienda de Valdepeñas) was a popular uprising that took place on 6 June 1808, at the beginning of the Spanish War of Independence, in the town of Valdepeñas, Ciudad Real, Castile-La Mancha. Valdepeñas is on the main road from Madrid to Andalusia.

zh.s: 巴尔德佩尼亚斯战役（西班牙语：Contienda de Valdepeñas）是一次民众起义，于1808年6月6日在西班牙独立战争初期发生，地点是卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼恰自治区雷阿尔城省的巴尔德佩尼亚斯镇。该镇位于马德里通往安达卢西亚的主要道路上。

en.s: The Battle of Stoney Creek was fought on 6 June 1813, during the War of 1812 near what is now Stoney Creek, Ontario, Canada. British units made a night attack on the American encampment, and due in large part to the capture of the two senior officers of the American force and an overestimation of British strength by the Americans, the outcome of the battle was a victory for the British, and a turning point in the defence of Upper Canada.

zh.s: 斯托尼溪战役于1813年6月6日爆发，是1812年战争的一部分，地点在今加拿大安大略省斯托尼溪附近。英军夜袭美军营地。美军两名高级军官被俘，加之美军高估了英军兵力，战斗以英军获胜告终，成为保卫上加拿大的转折点。

en.s: The First Battle of Higos Urco, near Chachapoyas in the General Command of Maynas, was part of the War of Independence of Maynas. The battle began on 6 June 1821. It was joined by small pro-independence and pro-Spanish forces. The battle was part of the campaign which led to the proclamation of Peruvian independence on 28 July 1821.

zh.s: 第一次希戈斯乌尔科战役发生在查查波亚斯附近的梅纳斯总司令辖区，是梅纳斯独立战争的一部分。战斗于1821年6月6日开始，参战者包括人数不多的亲独立派和亲西班牙派部队。这场战役属于一系列军事行动的一部分，最终秘鲁于1821年7月28日宣布独立。

en.s: The June Rebellion or the Paris Uprising of 1832 (French: Insurrection républicaine à Paris en juin 1832), was an anti-monarchist insurrection of Parisian republicans on 5 and 6 June 1832. The rebellion originated in an attempt of the republicans to reverse the establishment in 1830 of the July Monarchy of Louis-Philippe, shortly after the death of the king's powerful supporter, President of the Council Casimir Pierre Périer, on 16 May 1832. The death of Jean Maximilien Lamarque was a spark shortly before the revolutionaries rose to their barricades. The rebellion was the last outbreak of violence linked with the July Revolution of 1830.

zh.s: 六月起义又称1832年巴黎起义（法语：Insurrection républicaine à Paris en juin 1832），是巴黎共和派于1832年6月5日至6日发动的反君主制起义。共和派试图推翻1830年建立的路易-菲利普七月王朝。起义发生前，王政会议主席、国王的重要支持者卡西米尔·皮埃尔·佩里耶于1832年5月16日去世；让·马克西米利安·拉马克之死则成为起义者筑起街垒的导火索。这是与1830年七月革命相关的最后一次暴力事件。

en.t: The Young Men's Christian Association (YMCA) is founded in London
en.s: YMCA is a worldwide youth organization based in Vernier, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland, with more than 64 million beneficiaries in 120 countries. It has nearly 90,000 staff, some 920,000 volunteers and 12,000 branches worldwide. It was founded in London on 6 June 1844 by George Williams as the Young Men's Christian Association. The organization's stated aim is to put Christian values into practice by developing a healthy body, mind, and spirit.

zh.s: 基督教青年会（YMCA）于1844年6月6日在伦敦由乔治·威廉斯创立。该组织现以瑞士日内瓦州韦尔涅为总部，是一个全球性青年组织，在120个国家和地区拥有超过6,400万名受益者、近9万名员工、约92万名志愿者和12,000个分支机构。其宗旨是通过促进身心健康和精神成长，将基督教价值观付诸实践。

en.t: Queensland is established as a separate colony from New South Wales. The date is still celebrated as Queensland Day
en.s: Queensland (locally KWEENZ-land, commonly abbreviated as QLD or Qld) is a state in northeastern Australia, the second-largest and third-most-populous state in Australia. It is bordered by the Northern Territory, South Australia and New South Wales to the west, south-west and south, respectively. To the east, Queensland is bounded by the Coral Sea and the Pacific Ocean; to the state's north is the Torres Strait, separating the Australian mainland from Papua New Guinea, and the Gulf of Carpentaria to the north-west.

zh.t: 维多利亚女王签署昆士兰建省敕令
zh.s: 昆士兰位于澳大利亚东北部，是澳大利亚面积第二大、人口第三多的州。该州西、南和西南与北领地、南澳大利亚州和新南威尔士州接壤，东临珊瑚海和太平洋，北有托雷斯海峡（与巴布亚新几内亚相隔），西北为卡奔塔利亚湾。

en.s: The Battle of Good's Farm was a short skirmish between the Confederates and the Union in Jackson's Valley Campaign in the American Civil War. After a short fight, Confederate cavalryman Turner Ashby was killed. As Stonewall Jackson's army withdrew from the pressure of Maj. Gen. John C. Frémont's superior forces, moving from Harrisonburg toward Port Republic, Colonel Turner Ashby commanded the rear guard. On June 6, 1862, near Harrisonburg, the 1st New Jersey Cavalry attacked Ashby's position at Good's Farm. Although Ashby defeated the cavalry attack, a subsequent infantry engagement resulted in his horse being shot and Ashby charging ahead on foot.

zh.s: 古德农场战役是美国内战杰克逊谷地战役期间的一次短暂交战。邦联骑兵特纳·阿什比在交战中阵亡。斯通沃尔·杰克逊的军队在约翰·C·弗雷蒙特少将优势兵力的压力下撤退，从哈里森堡向共和港转移，特纳·阿什比上校负责指挥后卫。1862年6月6日，第一新泽西骑兵团在哈里森堡附近袭击阿什比驻守的古德农场。阿什比击退了骑兵进攻，但随后步兵交战时，他的马中弹，他便徒步冲锋。

en.s: The First Battle of Memphis was a naval battle fought on the Mississippi River immediately above the city of Memphis on June 6, 1862, during the American Civil War. The engagement was witnessed by many of the citizens of Memphis. It resulted in a crushing defeat for the Confederate forces, and marked the virtual eradication of a Confederate naval presence on the river. Despite the lopsided outcome, the Union Army failed to grasp its strategic significance. Its primary historical importance is that it was the last time civilians with no prior military experience were permitted to command ships in combat.

zh.s: 第一次孟菲斯海战于1862年6月6日在密西西比河孟菲斯市上游爆发，是美国内战期间的一场海战。许多孟菲斯居民目睹了交战。邦联军惨败，邦联海军几乎被逐出这条河。尽管结果悬殊，联邦军仍未认识到这场战斗的战略意义。它在历史上的主要意义是：这是最后一次允许没有军事经验的平民指挥军舰参加战斗。

en.s: The 1870 Oregon gubernatorial election took place on June 6, 1870 to elect the governor of the U.S. state of Oregon. The election matched Republican Joel Palmer against Democrat La Fayette Grover.

zh.s: 1870年俄勒冈州州长选举于6月6日举行，选举美国俄勒冈州州长。共和党候选人乔尔·帕尔默与民主党候选人拉斐特·格罗弗竞选。

en.t: Oregon holds its 1870 U.S. House election
en.s: Oregon voted for its single at-large U.S. House seat on June 6, 1870, before most states held their congressional elections. Democrat James H. Slater defeated Republican Joseph G. Wilson by a narrow margin to succeed Joseph Showalter Smith. The wider 1870–71 House election cycle continued in other states on separate dates.
en.n: June 6 applies to Oregon's House election, not every state in the 1870–71 U.S. House election cycle.

zh.t: 美国俄勒冈州举行1870年众议院选举
zh.s: 1870年6月6日，美国俄勒冈州选举本州唯一一名联邦众议员，比多数州更早投票。民主党候选人詹姆斯·斯莱特以微弱优势击败共和党候选人约瑟夫·威尔逊，接替约瑟夫·肖沃尔特·史密斯。1870至1871年间，其他州分别在不同日期举行众议院选举。
zh.n: 6月6日是俄勒冈州的投票日，不代表全美各州都在这一天投票。

en.s: The Battle of Embabo was fought 6 June 1882, between the Shewan forces of Negus Menelik II and the Gojjame forces of Negus Tekle Haymanot. The forces fought to gain control over the Oromia Region south of the Gibe River. The Gojjame forces under Tekle Haymanot were defeated. This is one of the three battles (along with Chelenqo and Adwa) which Donald Donham lists that led to Shewan supremacy over the rest of Ethiopia.

zh.s: 恩巴博战役于1882年6月6日爆发，交战双方是梅内利克二世国王领导的舍瓦军队与特克莱·海马诺特国王领导的戈贾姆军队。双方为争夺吉贝河以南的奥罗米亚地区而战。特克莱·海马诺特率领的戈贾姆军队被击败。唐纳德·唐纳姆将恩巴博战役与切伦科战役、阿杜瓦战役并列，认为这三场战役促成舍瓦对埃塞俄比亚其他地区的统治。

en.s: The Great Seattle Fire was a fire that destroyed the entire central business district of Seattle, Washington, on June 6, 1889. The conflagration lasted for less than a day, burning through the afternoon and into the night, during the same summer as the Great Spokane Fire and the Great Ellensburg Fire. Seattle quickly rebuilt using brick buildings that sat 20 feet (6.1 m) above the original street level.

zh.s: 西雅图大火于1889年6月6日发生，摧毁了华盛顿州西雅图的整个中央商业区。大火持续不到一天，从下午一直烧到夜间；同年夏天，斯波坎大火和埃伦斯堡大火也相继发生。西雅图迅速重建，采用砖砌建筑；这些建筑建在原街道平面以上20英尺（6.1米）处。

en.t: The Chicago "L" elevated rail system begins operation
en.s: The Chicago "L" (short for "elevated") is a rapid transit system serving the city of Chicago and some of its surrounding suburbs in the U.S. state of Illinois. The system is operated by the Chicago Transit Authority (CTA), one of the three service boards of the Northern Illinois Transit Authority (NITA).

zh.t: 芝加哥高架铁路开始运营
zh.s: 1892年6月6日，芝加哥首条高架铁路开始载客运营，一列蒸汽机车牵引四节木制车厢驶离第39街车站。

en.s: The 1898 Oregon gubernatorial election took place on June 6, 1898 to elect the governor of the U.S. state of Oregon. The election matched Republican Theodore Thurston Geer against Democratic State Senator W. R. King. Geer was the tenth governor since statehood, but the first native Oregonian to hold that position.

zh.s: 1898年俄勒冈州州长选举于6月6日举行，选举美国俄勒冈州州长。共和党候选人西奥多·瑟斯顿·吉尔与民主党州参议员W·R·金竞选。吉尔是俄勒冈州建州后的第十任州长，也是首位出生于俄勒冈州的州长。

en.t: The largest volcanic eruption of the 20th century began, forming the volcano Novarupta in the Alaska Peninsula
en.s: Novarupta is a volcano located on the Alaska Peninsula on a slope of Trident Volcano in Katmai National Park and Preserve, about 290 miles (470 km) southwest of Anchorage. Novarupta was formed in 1912, during the largest volcanic eruption of the 20th century, in which it released 30 times the volume of magma of the 1980 eruption of Mount St. Helens.

zh.t: 诺瓦鲁普塔火山开始喷发
zh.s: 诺瓦鲁普塔火山位于阿拉斯加半岛特里登特火山的山坡上，处于卡特迈国家公园和自然保护区内，距安克雷奇西南约470公里。它形成于1912年20世纪规模最大的火山喷发期间；该次喷发释放的岩浆量是1980年圣海伦火山喷发的30倍。

en.s: The elections for the members of the Philippine Assembly were held on June 6, 1916 pursuant to the Philippine Organic Act of 1902 which prescribed elections for every three years. The elected representatives would serve in the 4th Philippine Legislature from 1916 to 1919.

zh.s: 菲律宾议会议员选举于1916年6月6日举行，依据规定每三年举行一次选举的1902年《菲律宾组织法》进行。新当选的议员将在1916年至1919年间组成第四届菲律宾立法议会。

en.s: The Battle of Lutsk took place on the Eastern Front of World War I, from June 4 to June 6, 1916. It was the opening attack of the Russian Brusilov Offensive. The Russian 8th Army, under the overall command of Aleksei Brusilov, made a decisive breakthrough in the defenses of the Austro-Hungarian 4th Army in the area of the city of Lutsk, present-day Ukraine.

zh.s: 卢茨克战役是第一次世界大战东线战役之一，于1916年6月4日至6日爆发，是俄军布鲁西洛夫攻势的开场进攻。阿列克谢·布鲁西洛夫总司令指挥的俄国第8集团军，在今乌克兰卢茨克市附近，突破了奥匈帝国第4集团军的防线。

zh.s: 民主党选民于1916年3月7日至6月6日选出该党在1916年美国总统选举中的候选人。时任总统伍德罗·威尔逊经一系列初选和党团会议获得提名，最终在1916年6月14日至16日于密苏里州圣路易斯举行的民主党全国代表大会上确认。

en.s: The Battle of Flondar, also known as the defeat of Flondar (from the name of the most important hill reconquered by the Austro-Hungarians) took place during the First World War, consisting of a counterattack launched by selected Austrian units under the command of General Svetozar Borojević against the Italian positions around the Monte Ermada.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 弗隆达尔战役也称“弗隆达尔失利”，名称来自奥匈军队夺回的一处重要山丘。第一次世界大战期间，斯韦托扎尔·博罗耶维奇将军指挥奥地利部队反攻埃尔马达山一带的意大利阵地，形成这场战斗。

en.s: The Third Battle of the Aisne (French: 3e Bataille de l'Aisne) was part of the German spring offensive during World War I that focused on capturing the Chemin des Dames Ridge before the American Expeditionary Forces arrived completely in France. It was one of a series of offensives, known as the Kaiserschlacht, launched by the Germans in the spring and summer of 1918.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第三次埃纳河战役（法语：3e Bataille de l’Aisne）是第一次世界大战期间德国春季攻势的一部分，目标是在美国远征军全部抵达法国之前夺取谢曼德达姆高地。这是德国军队于1918年春夏发动的一系列攻势之一，合称“皇帝会战”。

en.s: Federal elections were held in Germany on 6 June 1920. The Social Democratic Party remained the largest party in the Reichstag, although it lost over a third of its seats. Voter turnout was 79.2%.

zh.s: 德国于1920年6月6日举行联邦选举。社会民主党仍是国会最大党，但失去了三分之一以上的席位。投票率为79.2%。

en.s: The Elections for the Members of the House of Representatives were held on June 6, 1922, pursuant to the Philippine Organic Act of 1902 which prescribed elections for every three years. The ruling Nacionalista Party was split into Colectivista (headed by Manuel Quezon) and Unipersonalista (headed by Sergio Osmeña). If combined, both blocs formed the largest party grouping in the House, with 64 of the 93 members. The Democrata Party emerged as the strongest opposition party since then Progresistas of the 1910s, winning 25 seats.

zh.s: 菲律宾于1922年6月6日举行众议院议员选举，依据1902年《菲律宾组织法》每三年举行一次选举的规定进行。执政的国民党分裂为由曼努埃尔·奎松领导的集体派和由塞尔希奥·奥斯梅尼亚领导的个人派。两派合计是众议院最大党团，共占93席中的64席。民主党成为自1910年代进步党以来最强的反对党，赢得25席。

en.s: Senatorial elections happened on June 6, 1922 in the Philippines under the Jones Law provisions. It was controversial when Senate President Manuel L. Quezon accused Sergio Osmeña of using public funds in campaigning which resulted to the Nacionalista Party to be split.

zh.s: 菲律宾于1922年6月6日依据《琼斯法》举行参议院选举。参议院议长曼努埃尔·L·奎松指控塞尔希奥·奥斯梅尼亚在竞选中使用公款，引发争议，并导致国民党分裂。

en.t: Walter Chrysler founds the Chrysler Corporation
en.s: Walter Chrysler founded the Chrysler Corporation on June 6, 1925, by reorganizing the Maxwell Motor Company. The new company followed the introduction of the first Chrysler car in 1924. It later became one of the major U.S. automakers.
en.n: June 6 is the founding date of the Chrysler Corporation; the first Chrysler-branded car had appeared in 1924.

zh.t: 沃尔特·克莱斯勒创立克莱斯勒公司
zh.s: 1925年6月6日，沃尔特·克莱斯勒以改组麦克斯韦汽车公司的方式成立克莱斯勒公司。第一款以克莱斯勒为名的汽车已在1924年推出。此后，克莱斯勒成为美国主要汽车制造商之一。
zh.n: 6月6日是克莱斯勒公司的成立日期；克莱斯勒品牌汽车此前已于1924年问世。

en.s: The 1926 Campeonato de Portugal Final was the final match of the 1925–26 Campeonato de Portugal, the 5th season of the Campeonato de Portugal, the Portuguese football knockout tournament, organized by the Portuguese Football Federation (FPF). The match was played on 6 June 1926 at the Campo do Ameal in Porto, and opposed Belenenses and Marítimo. Marítimo defeated Belenenses 2–0 to claim their first Campeonato de Portugal.

zh.s: 1926年葡萄牙锦标赛决赛是1925—1926赛季葡萄牙锦标赛的决赛，也是该项由葡萄牙足球协会主办的淘汰赛第五个赛季的收官战。比赛于1926年6月6日在波尔图的阿米亚尔球场举行，由贝伦人队对阵马里蒂莫队。马里蒂莫队以2比0获胜，首次夺冠。

en.s: The 1933 Los Angeles mayoral election took place on May 2, 1933, with a run-off election on June 6, 1933. Incumbent John Clinton Porter was defeated by Frank L. Shaw, a Los Angeles County Supervisor, in the runoff election. During the election, Shaw's citizenship was questioned as his birth records could not be located. Municipal elections in California, including Mayor of Los Angeles, are officially nonpartisan; candidates' party affiliations do not appear on the ballot.
en.n: This entry records the listed event date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 洛杉矶市长选举首轮投票于1933年5月2日举行，决选于6月6日举行。时任市长约翰·克林顿·波特在决选中败给洛杉矶县监事弗兰克·L·肖。竞选期间，由于找不到出生记录，肖的公民身份受到质疑。加州包括洛杉矶市长选举在内的市政选举在法律上不设党派，候选人的党派归属不会出现在选票上。

en.s: The 1935 Cupa României final was the second final of Romania's most prestigious football cup competition. It was disputed between Ripensia Timişoara and CFR București, and was won by CFR București after a game with 11 goals in extra time. It was the first cup trophy won by the feroviar team.

zh.s: 1935年罗马尼亚杯决赛是罗马尼亚最重要足球杯赛的第二届决赛，由蒂米什瓦拉里彭西亚队对阵布加勒斯特铁路队。布加勒斯特铁路队在加时赛中参加了一场共进11球的比赛后获胜，这是该队首次赢得杯赛冠军。

en.s: The Segovia Offensive was a Republican diversionary offensive which took place between 31 May and 6 June 1937, during the Spanish Civil War. The main goal of the offensive was to occupy Segovia and divert Nationalist forces from their advance on Bilbao. After a brief initial advance the offensive failed due to Nationalist air superiority.

zh.s: 塞哥维亚攻势是西班牙内战期间共和军发动的一次牵制性攻势，持续时间为1937年5月31日至6月6日。攻势的主要目标是占领塞哥维亚，并将国民军从向毕尔巴鄂推进的战线上调开。共和军最初短暂推进，之后因国民军掌握制空权而失败。

en.s: The 1937 Coppa Italia final was played on 6 June 1937 between Genova 1893 and Roma. Genoa won 1–0.

en.s: The action of 6 June 1942 was a single ship action fought during World War II. The German raider Stier encountered and sank the American tanker SS Stanvac Calcutta while cruising in the South Atlantic Ocean off Brazil.

zh.s: 1942年6月6日海战是第二次世界大战期间的一次单舰交战。德国袭击舰“施蒂尔”号在巴西外海的南大西洋航行时，遇到并击沉了美国油轮“斯坦瓦克·加尔各答”号。

en.s: The Japanese occupation of Kiska took place between 6 June 1942 and 28 July 1943 during the Aleutian Islands campaign of the American Theater and the Pacific Theater of World War II. The Japanese occupied Kiska and nearby Attu Island in order to protect the northern flank of the Japanese Empire.

zh.s: 日本于1942年6月6日至1943年7月28日占领基斯卡岛，属于第二次世界大战美洲战区和太平洋战区的阿留申群岛战役。日军占领基斯卡岛和附近的阿图岛，以保护日本帝国北翼。

en.s: Operation Mallard was the codename for an airborne forces operation which was conducted by the British Army on 6 June 1944, as part of the Normandy landings during World War II. The mission's objective was to airlift glider infantry of the 6th Airlanding Brigade and divisional troops to reinforce the British 6th Airborne Division on the left flank of the British invasion beaches. Using two landing zones, one to the west of the Caen canal and the other to the east of the River Orne, Mallard was the third airborne operation involving units of the division on D-Day.

zh.s: 野鸭行动是英国陆军于1944年6月6日实施的一次空降作战行动，属于第二次世界大战诺曼底登陆的一部分。任务目标是用滑翔机运送第6空降旅的滑翔机步兵和师属部队，增援英军第6空降师在盟军登陆海滩左翼的阵地。野鸭行动使用两个着陆区，一个在卡昂运河以西，另一个在奥恩河以东；这是D日当天该师部队参与的第三次空降行动。

en.t: Capture of the Caen Canal and Orne River bridges
en.s: The capture of the Caen Canal and Orne River bridges (wrongly known as Operation Deadstick [which in fact was a specialized glider exercise], and in official documents as Operation Coup de Main) was an operation by airborne forces of the British Army that took place in the early hours of 6 June 1944 as part of the Normandy landings of the Second World War.

zh.t: 夺取卡昂运河桥和奥恩河桥
zh.s: 1944年6月6日凌晨，英国陆军空降部队执行行动，夺取卡昂运河桥和奥恩河桥，作为第二次世界大战诺曼底登陆的一部分。这一行动常被误称为“死亡棍棒行动”（该名称实际指一项专门的滑翔机演练），官方文件中称为“Coup de Main行动”（突袭行动）。

en.s: Operation Overlord was the codename for the Battle of Normandy, the Allied operation that launched the successful invasion of German-occupied Western Europe during World War II. The operation was launched on 6 June 1944 (D-Day) with the Normandy landings (Operation Neptune). A 1,200-plane airborne assault preceded an amphibious assault involving more than 5,000 vessels.

zh.s: 霸王行动是诺曼底战役的代号，也是盟军在第二次世界大战期间成功登陆德占西欧的行动。行动于1944年6月6日（D日）随“海王星行动”（诺曼底登陆）启动。两栖登陆前，盟军先出动1,200架飞机实施空降突击，随后有5,000多艘船只参加两栖进攻。

en.s: The Battle of Hollandia (code-named Operation Reckless) was an engagement between Allies of World War II and Japanese forces during World War II. The majority of the Allied force was provided by the United States, with the bulk of two United States Army infantry divisions being committed on the ground. Air and naval support consisted largely of U.S. assets, although Australia also provided air support during preliminary operations and a naval bombardment force. The battle took place between 22 April and 6 June 1944 and formed part of the New Guinea campaign.

zh.s: 荷兰迪亚战役又称“鲁莽行动”，是第二次世界大战期间盟军与日军的一次交战。盟军部队主要由美国提供，地面主力是两支美国陆军步兵师。空中和海上支援也主要由美国提供；澳大利亚则在前期行动中提供空中支援，并派出海军炮击部队。战役于1944年4月22日至6月6日进行，是新几内亚战役的一部分。

en.s: The first Jassy–Kishinev offensive, named after the two major cities in the area, Jassy and Kishinev, was a series of military engagements between 8 April and 6 June 1944 (according to David Glantz) by the Soviet Union and Axis powers. Richard C. Hall also refers to a first Jassy–Kishinev operation which began on 5 April, without providing an exact date for its end.

zh.t: 第一次雅西—基希讷乌攻势
zh.s: 第一次雅西—基希讷乌攻势以该地区两座主要城市雅西和基希讷乌命名。根据戴维·格兰茨的说法，这是一系列苏联与轴心国部队之间的军事交战，时间为1944年4月8日至6月6日。理查德·C·霍尔也提到第一次雅西—基希讷乌行动于4月5日开始，但没有给出确切结束日期。

en.s: The liberation of France (French: libération de la France) in the Second World War was accomplished through the combined military efforts of the Allied Powers including Free French forces in London and Africa, and the French Resistance. Nazi Germany invaded France in May 1940. Their rapid advance through the almost undefended Ardennes caused a crisis in the French government; the French Third Republic dissolved itself in July, and handed over absolute power to Marshal Philippe Pétain, an elderly hero of World War I.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，盟军各国、伦敦和非洲的自由法国部队，以及法国抵抗运动共同完成了法国解放。纳粹德国于1940年5月入侵法国，迅速穿过几乎没有防守的阿登地区，引发法国政府危机。法兰西第三共和国于同年7月自行解散，并将绝对权力交给一战老将、年迈的菲利普·贝当元帅。

en.s: Juno Beach was one of five beaches of the Allied invasion of German-occupied France in the Normandy landings on 6 June 1944 during the Second World War. The beach spanned from Courseulles, a village just east of the British beach Gold, to Saint-Aubin-sur-Mer, and just west of the British beach Sword.

zh.s: 朱诺海滩是第二次世界大战诺曼底登陆中，盟军于1944年6月6日入侵德占法国时的五个登陆海滩之一。海滩从库尔瑟耶村延伸至圣奥班叙梅尔；库尔瑟耶位于英军金滩以东，圣奥班叙梅尔则在英军剑滩以西。

en.s: La Pointe du Hoc (French pronunciation: [pwɛ̃t dy ɔk]) is a promontory with a 35-metre (110 ft) cliff overlooking the English Channel on the northwestern coast of Normandy in the Calvados department, France. In World War II, Pointe du Hoc was the location of a series of German bunkers and machine gun posts. Prior to the invasion of Normandy, the German army fortified the area with concrete casemates and gun pits.

zh.s: 奥克角（法语发音：[pwɛ̃t dy ɔk]）是诺曼底西北海岸的一处岬角，位于法国卡尔瓦多斯省，临英吉利海峡，崖壁高35米（110英尺）。第二次世界大战期间，这里设有一系列德军碉堡和机枪阵地。诺曼底登陆前，德军以混凝土炮廓和炮位加固该地区。

en.s: Sword, commonly known as Sword Beach, was the code name given to one of the five main landing areas along the Normandy coast during the initial assault phase, Operation Neptune, of Operation Overlord. The Allied invasion of German-occupied France commenced on 6 June 1944. Stretching 8 kilometres (5.0 mi) from Ouistreham to Saint-Aubin-sur-Mer, the beach proved to be the easternmost landing site of the invasion after the abortion of an attack on a sixth beach, code-named Band.

zh.s: “剑”是霸王行动中“海王星行动”最初突击阶段，盟军在诺曼底海岸五个主要登陆区之一使用的代号，通常称为剑滩。盟军于1944年6月6日开始入侵德占法国。海滩从乌伊斯特勒昂延伸至圣奥班叙梅尔，长8公里（5英里）。原定的第六处登陆区“班德”遭取消后，剑滩成为最东端的登陆点。

en.s: Utah, commonly known as Utah Beach, was the code name for one of the five sectors of the Allied invasion of German-occupied France in the Normandy landings on June 6, 1944 (D-Day), during World War II. The westernmost of the five code-named landing beaches in Normandy, Utah is on the Cotentin Peninsula, west of the mouths of the Douve and Vire rivers.

zh.s: “犹他”是第二次世界大战诺曼底登陆期间，1944年6月6日（D日）盟军入侵德占法国时五个登陆区之一的代号，通常称为犹他海滩。它是诺曼底五个代号海滩中最西端的一处，位于科唐坦半岛、多夫河和维尔河河口以西。

en.s: Omaha Beach was one of five Allied beach landing sectors of the amphibious assault component of Operation Overlord during the Second World War. On June 6, 1944, the Allies invaded German-occupied France with the Normandy landings. "Omaha" refers to an 8-kilometer (5 mi) section of the coast of Normandy, France, facing the English Channel, from west of Sainte-Honorine-des-Pertes to east of Vierville-sur-Mer on the right bank of the Douve river estuary.

zh.s: 奥马哈海滩是第二次世界大战期间霸王行动两栖进攻中的五个盟军登陆区之一。1944年6月6日，盟军通过诺曼底登陆入侵德占法国。“奥马哈”指法国诺曼底海岸一段8公里（5英里）的海岸线，面向英吉利海峡，西起圣奥诺里娜德佩尔特以西，东至维尔河口右岸的维耶维尔叙梅尔以东。

en.s: The Brécourt Manor Assault (6 June 1944) during the US parachute assault of the Normandy Invasion of World War II is often cited as a classic example of small-unit tactics and leadership in overcoming a larger enemy force.

zh.s: 1944年6月6日诺曼底登陆期间，美军实施了布雷库尔庄园突袭。这次行动常被视为小部队凭借战术和领导力战胜人数更多敌军的经典案例。

en.s: Gold, commonly known as Gold Beach, was the code name for one of the five areas of the Allied invasion of German-occupied France in the Normandy landings on 6 June 1944, during the Second World War. Gold, the central of the five areas, was located between Port-en-Bessin on the west and the Lieu-dit La Rivière in Ver-sur-Mer on the east.

zh.s: “金”是第二次世界大战诺曼底登陆期间，1944年6月6日盟军入侵德占法国的五个登陆区之一的代号，通常称为金滩。它位于五个登陆区中央，西起波尔坦贝桑，东至维尔叙梅尔的拉里维埃村。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Ecuador on 6 June 1948. The elections were supervised by the Supreme Electoral Tribunal for the first time. The result was a victory for Galo Plaza of the National Democratic Civic Movement. He was inaugurated as President on 1 September 1948.

en.s: The Battle of Ban Pa Dong was fought between 31 January and 6 June 1961 in Ban Pa Dong, the Kingdom of Laos. Troops from the People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) and the Pathet Lao attacked Hmong recruits being trained as Auto Defense Choc guerrillas via Operation Momentum.

zh.s: 班巴栋战役于1961年1月31日至6月6日在老挝王国的班巴栋爆发。越南人民军和巴特寮部队通过“势头行动”进攻苗族新兵；这些新兵正接受训练，准备成为“自卫突击队”游击队员。

en.s: El Porteñazo (2 June 1962 – 6 June 1962) was a short-lived Communist military rebellion against the government of Rómulo Betancourt in Venezuela, in which rebels attempted to take over the city of Puerto Cabello, located ~75 miles (121 km) West of the capital Caracas. The rebellion was on a substantially larger scale than that of El Carupanazo a month earlier.

zh.t: 埃尔波尔特尼亚索起义
zh.s: 埃尔波尔特尼亚索起义（1962年6月2日至6日）是委内瑞拉发生的一场短暂的共产主义军事叛乱，反抗罗慕洛·贝坦科尔特政府。叛军试图占领波多卡贝略市，该市位于首都加拉加斯以西约75英里（121公里）处。起义规模远大于一个月前发生的埃尔卡鲁帕纳索起义。

en.s: Ammunition Hill (Hebrew: גִּבְעַת הַתַּחְמֹשֶׁת, Giv'at HaTahmoshet) was a fortified Jordanian military post in the northern part of Jordanian-ruled East Jerusalem and the western slope of Mount Scopus. It was the site of one of the fiercest battles of the Six-Day War. Ammunition Hill is now a national memorial site.

zh.s: 弹药山原是约旦军队在东耶路撒冷北部、斯科普斯山西坡的一处防御阵地。六日战争期间，这里爆发了最激烈的战斗之一；如今弹药山是国家纪念地。

en.s: The 1968 Bulgarian Cup final was the 28th final of the Bulgarian Cup (in this period the tournament was named Cup of the Soviet Army), and was contested between Spartak Sofia and Beroe Stara Zagora on 6 June 1968 at Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia. Spartak won the final 3–2 after extra time, claiming their first ever Bulgarian Cup title.

zh.s: 1968年保加利亚杯决赛是保加利亚杯（当时称苏联陆军杯）的第28届决赛。索非亚斯巴达克队与旧扎戈拉贝罗队于1968年6月6日在索非亚瓦西尔·列夫斯基国家体育场交手。斯巴达克队在加时赛后以3比2获胜，首次夺得保加利亚杯冠军。

en.s: The Battle of Coral–Balmoral (12 May – 6 June 1968) was a series of actions fought during the Vietnam War between the 1st Australian Task Force (1 ATF) and the North Vietnamese People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) 7th Division and Viet Cong (VC) Main Force units, 40 kilometres (25 mi) north-east of Saigon.

en.t: Soyuz 11 launches for the Salyut 1 space station
en.s: On June 6, 1971, the Soviet Union launched Soyuz 11 from Baikonur Cosmodrome, in present-day Kazakhstan. Georgy Dobrovolsky, Vladislav Volkov and Viktor Patsayev were aboard, bound for the Salyut 1 space station.

zh.t: 联盟11号发射，飞往礼炮1号空间站

en.s: Hughes Airwest Flight 706 was a regularly scheduled flight operated by American domestic airline Hughes Airwest from Los Angeles, California, to Seattle, Washington, with several intermediate stops. On Sunday, June 6, 1971, the McDonnell Douglas DC-9 serving as Flight 706 departed Los Angeles just after 6 p.m. en route to Seattle as a McDonnell Douglas F-4 Phantom II of the United States Marine Corps was approaching Marine Corps Air Station El Toro near Irvine at the end of a flight from Naval Air Station Fallon in Nevada.

zh.t: 休斯航空西部航空706号班机
zh.s: 休斯航空西部航空706号班机是美国国内航空公司休斯航空西部航空运营的定期航班，从加利福尼亚州洛杉矶飞往华盛顿州西雅图，中途停靠数站。1971年6月6日（星期日）下午6时刚过，执飞706号班机的麦克唐纳·道格拉斯DC-9客机从洛杉矶起飞前往西雅图；与此同时，美国海军陆战队一架麦克唐纳·道格拉斯F-4“鬼怪II”战斗机正飞近尔湾附近的埃尔托罗海军陆战队航空站，结束从内华达州法伦海军航空站出发的飞行。

en.s: The 1972 New Jersey Democratic presidential primary was held on June 6, 1972, in New Jersey as one of the Democratic Party's statewide nomination contests ahead of the 1972 United States presidential election. In the binding delegate primary, candidates pledged to support George McGovern at the 1972 Democratic National Convention won contests for delegates at-large and most of the county races. Delegates pledged to support Hubert H. Humphrey carried Camden and Ocean counties.

zh.t: 1972年新泽西州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 1972年6月6日，新泽西州举行民主党总统初选。在决定全国代表大会代表的投票中，承诺支持乔治·麦戈文的候选人赢得全州代表席位和大部分县的代表席位；支持休伯特·H·汉弗莱的候选人则在卡姆登县和海洋县胜出。

en.s: From March 7 to June 6, 1972, voters of the Republican Party chose its nominee for president in the 1972 United States presidential election. Incumbent President Richard Nixon was again selected as the nominee through a series of primary elections and caucuses culminating in the 1972 Republican National Convention held from August 21 to August 23, 1972, in Miami, Florida.

en.s: The 1978 San Jose mayoral election was held to elect the mayor of San Jose, California. The runoff was won by incumbent mayor Janet Gray Hayes.

en.t: 1982 British Army Gazelle friendly fire incident
en.s: On 6 June 1982, during the Falklands War, the British Royal Navy Type 42 destroyer HMS Cardiff engaged and destroyed a British Army Gazelle helicopter, serial number XX377, in a friendly fire incident, killing all four occupants. Cardiff, on the lookout for aircraft flying supplies to the Argentine forces occupying the Falkland Islands, had misidentified the helicopter as an enemy C-130 Hercules. Although the helicopter's loss was initially blamed on enemy action, a subsequent inquiry found Cardiff's missiles to be the cause. On the night of 5 June, HMS Cardiff was stationed to the east of the islands to provide gunfire support to the land forces and intercept enemy aircraft.

zh.t: 1982年英国陆军瞪羚直升机误击事件
zh.s: 1982年6月6日，马岛战争期间，英国皇家海军42型驱逐舰“加的夫”号误将英国陆军一架编号XX377的瞪羚直升机击落，机上4人全部遇难。“加的夫”号当时负责监视向占领福克兰群岛（马尔维纳斯群岛）的阿根廷军队运输补给的飞机，误把直升机识别为敌方C-130“大力神”运输机。直升机失事最初被归咎于敌方行动，后续调查认定是“加的夫”号发射的导弹导致事故。6月5日晚，“加的夫”号驻扎在群岛东侧，为地面部队提供舰炮支援并拦截敌机。

en.s: The 1982 Lebanon War (Hebrew: מלחמת לבנון הראשונה‎‎, Milhemet Levanon Harishona, "the first Lebanon war"), called Operation Peace for Galilee (Hebrew: מבצע שלום הגליל, or מבצע של"ג‎‎ Mivtsa Shlom HaGalil or Mivtsa Sheleg;by Israel, and later known in Israel as the Lebanon War and First Lebanon War, and Arabic: الاجتياح‎‎, Al-ijtiyāḥ, "the invasion") by the Arabs, began on 6 June 1982, when the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) invaded southern Lebanon, after repeated attacks and counter-attacks between the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO) operating in southern Lebanon and the IDF that had caused civilian casualties on both sides of the border.

zh.s: 1982年黎巴嫩战争于1982年6月6日爆发。以色列称之为“加利利和平行动”（希伯来语：מבצע שלום הגליל），后来在以色列称为“黎巴嫩战争”或“第一次黎巴嫩战争”；阿拉伯方面称其为“入侵”（阿拉伯语：الاجتياح）。此前，巴勒斯坦解放组织在黎巴嫩南部活动，与以色列国防军多次互相袭击和反击，造成边境两侧平民伤亡；随后以色列国防军入侵黎巴嫩南部。

en.s: The 1984 Greek Cup final was the 40th final of the Greek Cup. The match took place on 6 June 1984 at the Olympic Stadium. The contesting teams were Panathinaikos and AEL. zh.s: 1984年希腊杯决赛是希腊杯第40届决赛，于1984年6月6日在奥林匹克体育场举行。帕纳辛奈科斯队对阵拉里萨队。这是帕纳辛奈科斯队在其76年历史中的第15次希腊杯决赛，也是拉里萨队在其20年历史中的第二次希腊杯决赛。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Slovakia on 5 and 6 June 1992 alongside federal elections. The Movement for a Democratic Slovakia emerged as the largest party, winning 74 of the 150 seats in the National Council and forming a minority government under Vladimír Mečiar. The threshold had been raised from 3% (for the Slovak parliamentary election in 1990) to 5%. In 1993, the Slovak National Party joined the government led by Prime Minister Mečiar. After a number of MPs left both parties of the ruling coalition, the Mečiar cabinet was brought down by a vote of non-confidence in March 1994.

zh.s: 斯洛伐克于1992年6月5日至6日举行议会选举，同时举行联邦选举。争取民主斯洛伐克运动成为最大党，赢得国民议会150席中的74席，并在弗拉基米尔·梅恰尔领导下组建少数政府。选举门槛从1990年斯洛伐克议会选举时的3%提高到5%。1993年斯洛伐克民族党加入梅恰尔领导的政府。执政联盟两党的一些议员后来相继退党，梅恰尔内阁于1994年3月在不信任投票中倒台。

en.s: Copa Airlines Flight 201 was a regularly scheduled passenger flight from Tocumen International Airport in Panama City, Panama, to Alfonso Bonilla Aragón International Airport in Cali, Colombia. On 6 June 1992, the Boeing 737-200 operating the route rolled, entered a steep dive, disintegrated in mid-air, and crashed into the jungle of the Darién Gap 29 minutes after takeoff, killing all 47 people on board.

zh.t: 巴拿马航空201号班机空难
zh.s: 巴拿马航空201号班机是一趟定期客运航班，从巴拿马巴拿马城的托库门国际机场飞往哥伦比亚卡利的阿方索·博尼利亚·阿拉贡国际机场。1992年6月6日，执飞该航线的波音737-200发生翻滚，随后急速俯冲，在空中解体，并于起飞29分钟后坠入达连隘口的丛林，机上47人全部遇难。

en.s: National Council elections were held in the Czech part of Czechoslovakia on 5 and 6 June 1992, alongside federal elections. en.s: The 1993 Spanish general election was held on Sunday, 6 June 1993, to elect the 5th Cortes Generales of the Kingdom of Spain. All 350 seats in the Congress of Deputies were up for election, as well as 208 of 256 seats in the Senate. The Spanish Socialist Workers' Party under Felipe González achieved the largest number of votes and seats for the fourth consecutive time, though it lost its absolute majority in both chambers of the Cortes. In contrast, José María Aznar's People's Party won a large share of the vote, thus increasing their seats in both the Congress and the Senate and consolidating its position as the main opposition party.

zh.s: 西班牙于1993年6月6日（星期日）举行大选，选出西班牙王国第5届议会。众议院350个席位和参议院256个席位中的208席全部改选。费利佩·冈萨雷斯领导的西班牙工人社会党连续第四次赢得最多选票和席位，但失去了在两院的绝对多数。何塞·玛丽亚·阿斯纳尔领导的人民党则获得较高得票率，在众议院和参议院均增加席位，并巩固了主要反对党的地位。

en.s: The United States Senate special election runoff in Texas, 1993 was held on June 6, 1993 to replace U.S. senator Lloyd Bentsen. en.s: China Northwest Airlines Flight 2303 was a domestic flight from Xi'an to Guangzhou, People's Republic of China. On June 6, 1994, the aircraft operating the flight, a Tupolev Tu-154M, broke up in-flight and crashed as a result of an autopilot malfunction which caused violent shaking and overstressed the airframe. All 160 people on board were killed. As of 2026, it remains the deadliest airplane crash ever in mainland China.

zh.t: 中国西北航空2303号班机空难
zh.s: 中国西北航空2303号班机是一趟中国国内航班，从西安飞往广州。1994年6月6日，执飞该航班的图-154M客机因自动驾驶系统故障发生剧烈震动，机体在空中解体并坠毁。机上160人全部遇难。截至2026年，这仍是中国大陆死亡人数最多的空难。

en.s: The 1995 Denver mayoral election took place on took place on June 6, 1995, following a primary election on May 2, 1995. Incumbent Mayor Wellington Webb ran for re-election to a second term. He was challenged by City Councilwoman Mary DeGroot, City Auditor Bob Crider, and attorney John Frew. Webb's administration supervised the construction of the Denver International Airport, but repeated delays in the airport's opening attracted criticism in the lead-up to the 1995 election.

en.t: Eastern Mediterranean event. A near-Earth asteroid estimated at ten meters in diameter explodes over the Mediterranean Sea between Greece and Libya. The explosion is estimated to have a force of 26 kilotons, slightly more powerful than the Nagasaki atomic bomb
en.s: The 2002 Eastern Mediterranean Event was a high-energy upper atmosphere explosion over the Mediterranean Sea, around 34°N 21°E (between Libya and Crete) on June 6, 2002. This explosion, similar in power to a small atomic bomb, has been related to a small asteroid undetected while approaching Earth. The object disintegrated as a meteor air burst over the sea, and no meteorite fragments were recovered.

It was played at the Olympiastadion in Berlin, Germany, on 6 June 2015, between Italian side Juventus and Spanish side Barcelona.

The final was contested by Kerry of Munster and Derry of Ulster, with Kerry winning by 1-20 to 0-12.

The match was contested by Trikala, winners of the 2014–15 Football League 2 Cup, and Nestos Chrysoupoli, the 2014–15 Greek Amateurs' Cup winners.

en.s: The battle of Raqqa (2017), also known as the second battle of Raqqa, was the fifth and final phase of the Raqqa campaign (2016–2017) launched by the Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) against the Islamic State (IS) with an aim to seize the city of Raqqa, the de facto capital of ISIL since 2014. The battle began on 6 June 2017, and was supported by airstrikes and ground troops from the US-led coalition. The operation was named the "Great Battle" by the SDF. It concluded on 17 October 2017, with the SDF fully capturing the city of Raqqa.

zh.s: 2017年拉卡战役又称第二次拉卡战役，是叙利亚民主力量2016—2017年拉卡攻势的第五阶段，也是最后阶段。叙利亚民主力量旨在夺取自2014年以来一直是“伊拉克和黎凡特伊斯兰国”事实首都的拉卡市。战役于2017年6月6日开始，得到美国领导的联军空袭和地面部队支援。叙利亚民主力量将行动称为“伟大战役”。战斗于2017年10月17日结束，叙利亚民主力量完全控制拉卡市。

en.s: A by-election for the United Kingdom parliamentary constituency of Peterborough was held on 6 June 2019. It was triggered by incumbent Labour Party MP Fiona Onasanya being removed from office via a recall petition, following her conviction of perverting the course of justice in relation to a speeding offence. Lisa Forbes, also of Labour, won the by-election with a reduced majority, narrowly holding-off the Brexit Party's Mike Greene.

en.s: The 2021 Saxony-Anhalt state election was held on 6 June 2021 to elect the 8th Landtag of Saxony-Anhalt. The outgoing government was coalition of the Christian Democratic Union (CDU), Social Democratic Party (SPD), and The Greens, led by Minister-President Reiner Haseloff. The CDU won an unexpectedly strong 37.1% of votes, an increase of 7.4 percentage points. The opposition Alternative for Germany (AfD) finished on 20.8%, a decline of 3.4 percentage points.

en.t: Grêmio wins the 2021 Recopa Gaúcha final

en.t: 2022 vote of confidence in the Conservative Party leadership of Boris Johnson
en.s: On 6 June 2022, a vote of confidence was held amongst Conservative Party MPs on the prime minister, Boris Johnson's, leadership of their party. Johnson won the vote with the support of 211 Conservative members of Parliament, 58.8% of the total. Out of 359 MPs, 148 (41.2%) voted against him. Despite this, just over a month later, on 7 July, following another scandal and mass resignations from his government, Johnson announced he would resign.

zh.t: 2022年保守党对鲍里斯·约翰逊党魁职务的信任投票
zh.s: 保守党议员于2022年6月6日就首相鲍里斯·约翰逊的党魁职务举行信任投票。约翰逊获得211名保守党议员支持，占总数的58.8%。359名议员中有148人（41.2%）投票反对他。尽管如此，约翰逊一个多月后的7月7日，在政府再度陷入丑闻并出现大规模辞职后，宣布将辞职。

en.t: 2023 Western Australian Labor Party leadership election
en.s: A leadership election for the Western Australian Labor Party occurred on 6 June 2023 following the resignation of party leader and premier of Western Australia Mark McGowan in June 2023. The three contenders to replace McGowan were Roger Cook, Amber-Jade Sanderson and Rita Saffioti. Saffioti withdrew on 30 May in exchange for being Cook's deputy, and Sanderson withdrew on 30 May, leaving Cook as the sole nominee for leader.

zh.t: 2023年西澳大利亚工党党魁选举
zh.s: 西澳大利亚工党于2023年6月6日举行党魁选举，起因是党魁兼西澳大利亚州州长马克·麦高恩于当年6月辞职。接替麦高恩的三名候选人是罗杰·库克、安珀-杰德·桑德森和丽塔·萨菲奥蒂。萨菲奥蒂于5月30日退出竞选，以换取担任库克的副手；桑德森也于5月30日退出，最终只剩库克一人参选。

en.s: The 2023 Denver mayoral election was held on April 4, 2023, to elect the mayor of Denver, Colorado, with a runoff held on June 6. The election was officially nonpartisan and was held concurrently with elections for the Denver City Council, as well as city auditor and city clerk and recorder. Incumbent mayor Michael Hancock was term-limited and could not seek a fourth term in office.

en.s: The 2025 Against All Odds was a professional wrestling event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA). It took place on June 6, 2025, at the Mullett Arena in Tempe, Arizona, and aired on TNA+. It was the 14th event under the Against All Odds chronology. Wrestlers from WWE's NXT brand, with which TNA has a partnership, also appeared at the event.

zh.s: 2025年《不计代价》是TNA主办的职业摔角赛事，于2025年6月6日在亚利桑那州坦佩的马利特竞技场举行，并在TNA+平台播出。这是《不计代价》系列第14届赛事。由于TNA与WWE旗下NXT品牌合作，NXT摔角手也参加了比赛。
